limitations: Branch and PR mutation capabilities are schema-verified but intentionally not side-effect-tested because connector probing must remain read-only unless a substantive role-authorized mutation is required.
CAS conflict rejection is not stress-tested by deliberately supplying a stale SHA; the connector contract requires a current blob SHA and this invocation exercises the positive CAS path only.
This evidence proves feasibility for the reproducibility_auditor's repository workflow, not all 17 active roles and not provider-independent exactly-once semantics.
Tool-surface presence does not override repository hard boundaries or confer primary-writer authority.
